tools.name: mindmaps
tools.description: Create and edit mind maps from an outline or a project file. Export PNG, SVG and PDF, save locally and share a link. No account required.

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description:
Generates a strong random password with a cryptographically secure generator.

WHEN TO USE: the user asks for a password or a random key.

HOW IT WORKS: always uses upper and lower case letters; numbers and symbols are optional. Each selected kind of character appears at least once. length: 8 to 64

tools.name: compare_timezones
tools.description:
Converts one moment across several time zones, daylight saving time included.

WHEN TO USE: "what time is it in…", scheduling a meeting across cities, checking whether a time falls at night or on another day somewhere.

HOW IT WORKS:
- zones: IANA time zone names in Area/City form — America/Sao_Paul

tools.name: data_to_chart
tools.description:
Draws a chart from a CSV table and returns it as an image.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants to see data as a chart, or needs a chart image for a document, a README, a slide or a chat.

HOW IT WORKS:
- csv: a header row, then data rows. First column: the category (or x value); the next columns: numbers.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "receive_email" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.tools.ciromaciel.click" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: receive_email, compare_timezones, text_to_speech, generate_favicon, web_to_markdown · Private data: mindmaps, generate_password, data_to_chart, text_to_speech, generate_favicon, generate_background, web_to_markdown · Public sink: receive_email, mindmaps, text_to_speech · Destructive: compare_timezones, text_to_speech, generate_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: receive_email, compare_timezones, text_to_speech, generate_favicon, web_to_markdown · Private data: mindmaps, generate_password, data_to_chart, text_to_speech, generate_favicon, generate_background, web_to_markdown · Public sink: receive_email, mindmaps, text_to_speech · Destructive: compare_timezones, text_to_speech, generate_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
